column1: Requirement Text
The system shall allow users to create a new account using their email address and a password.
The system shall validate that the user-provided email address is in a valid format.
The system shall enforce password complexity rules: at least 8 characters, one uppercase letter, one lowercase letter, one number, and one special character.
The system shall send a verification email to the user's registered email address upon account creation.
The system shall require users to verify their email address before they can log in for the first time.
The system shall allow users to log in using their registered email address and password.
The system shall implement a mechanism to prevent brute-force login attacks, such as account lockout after multiple failed attempts.
The system shall provide a 'Remember Me' option to keep users logged in.
The system shall allow users to request a password reset if they have forgotten their password.
The system shall send a password reset link to the user's registered email address.
The password reset link shall expire after a configurable amount of time (e.g., 1 hour).
The system shall allow logged-in users to change their password.
The system shall require the user to enter their current password before changing to a new one.
The system shall display a personalized dashboard to the user upon successful login.
The dashboard shall provide an overview of the user's recent activity.
The system shall allow users to create, read, update, and delete (CRUD) their own profile information.
User profiles shall include fields for first name, last name, and profile picture.
The system shall allow users to upload a profile picture in JPG or PNG format.
The maximum file size for a profile picture shall be 5MB.
The system shall provide an administrative interface for managing users.
Administrators shall be able to create, view, edit, and delete user accounts.
Administrators shall be able to assign roles and permissions to users.
The system shall support at least three user roles: Administrator, Editor, and Viewer.
The system shall restrict access to features based on the user's assigned role.
The system shall provide a search functionality to find users by name or email.
The system shall log all administrative actions for auditing purposes.
The system shall allow users to create and manage projects.
Each project shall have a unique name, a description, and a start/end date.
The system shall allow users to assign other users to a project.
The system shall send an email notification to a user when they are assigned to a new project.
The system shall allow users to define tasks within a project.
Each task shall have a title, description, status (e.g., To Do, In Progress, Done), and an assignee.
The system shall allow users to comment on tasks.
The system shall support file attachments for tasks.
The system shall provide a Kanban board view for tasks within a project.
The system shall allow users to filter tasks by status, assignee, or other criteria.
The system shall generate reports on project progress.
Reports shall be exportable in PDF and CSV formats.
The system shall provide a global search functionality that searches across projects, tasks, and comments.
The search results shall be ranked by relevance.
The system shall be available 24/7 with a guaranteed uptime of 99.5%.
The average response time for all user-facing pages shall be less than 2 seconds.
The system shall be able to handle 1,000 concurrent users without significant performance degradation.
The system shall be horizontally scalable to accommodate future growth in user numbers.
All communication between the client and the server shall be encrypted using TLS 1.2 or higher.
The system shall encrypt all sensitive user data stored in the database, including passwords and personal information.
Passwords shall be hashed using a strong, one-way hashing algorithm like Argon2.
The system shall be protected against common security vulnerabilities, including those listed in the OWASP Top 10 (e.g., SQL Injection, XSS, CSRF).
The system shall undergo regular security audits and penetration testing.
The system shall maintain a comprehensive audit trail of all data modifications.
The user interface shall be intuitive, user-friendly, and follow established design principles.
The system shall be responsive and provide a consistent user experience across desktops, tablets, and mobile devices.
The system shall comply with the Web Content Accessibility Guidelines (WCAG) 2.1 Level AA.
The system shall provide clear and helpful error messages to guide the user.
The system shall support internationalization (i18n) and localization (l10n) for English and Japanese languages.
The system shall provide a RESTful API for integration with third-party applications.
The API shall be well-documented using a standard like OpenAPI (Swagger).
The API shall use OAuth 2.0 for authentication and authorization.
The system shall perform daily backups of the database.
The backup and recovery process shall be tested regularly.
The system shall have a disaster recovery plan in place.
The system shall be monitored for performance, availability, and errors.
Alerts shall be configured to notify the development team of any critical issues.
The application shall be deployed using a containerization technology like Docker.
The deployment process shall be automated using a CI/CD pipeline.
The system shall allow users to subscribe to email notifications for various events.
Users shall be able to manage their notification preferences.
The system shall provide a WYSIWYG editor for creating and editing rich text content.
The system shall support real-time collaboration on shared documents.
The system shall integrate with a version control system (e.g., Git) for managing code.
The system shall provide a feature for users to submit feedback.
The system shall include a comprehensive help documentation for end-users.
The system shall allow users to export their data in a machine-readable format (e.g., JSON, CSV).
The system shall implement rate limiting on the API to prevent abuse.
The system shall provide a status page to communicate system uptime and incidents.
The system shall be compatible with the latest stable versions of major web browsers (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge).
The system's database schema shall be designed to be extensible for future requirements.
The system shall use a modern, component-based frontend framework (e.g., React, Vue, or Angular).
The backend shall be built using a robust and scalable language and framework (e.g., Python/Django, Node.js/Express).
The system shall have a comprehensive suite of automated tests, including unit, integration, and end-to-end tests.
Test coverage shall be maintained above 80%.
The system shall log all application errors to a centralized logging service.
The system shall provide role-based access control (RBAC) for all features.
The system shall allow for single sign-on (SSO) integration with identity providers like Google or Microsoft.
The system shall provide a two-factor authentication (2FA) option for enhanced security.
The system shall allow users to view their activity history.
The system shall provide a mechanism for archiving old projects.
The system shall be GDPR compliant for handling user data.
The system shall allow users to permanently delete their account and all associated data.
The system shall display a 'Terms of Service' and 'Privacy Policy' that users must agree to during registration.
The system shall provide a 'dark mode' option for the user interface.
The system shall cache frequently accessed data to improve performance.
The system shall use a content delivery network (CDN) to serve static assets.
The system shall gracefully handle and report API errors to the client.
The system shall be designed with a microservices architecture to allow for independent scaling and deployment of services.
The system shall provide a public-facing API for developers.
The system shall have a clear and consistent naming convention for all API endpoints.
The system shall version its API to ensure backward compatibility.
The system shall provide SDKs for popular programming languages to facilitate API integration.
The system shall include a sandbox environment for developers to test their API integrations.
